context: A teacher walks a teen through cultural studies
purpose: Teach: 伏線/転機/崇/施す/骨太/通り抜け/ろくな/根付い

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、伏線回収の手法、よく研究しましたね。
lines.en: Sakura, you really did thorough research on how to structure foreshadowing and payoff.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Measured delivery with gentle emphasis on 「よく」. Recognition without over-praise. Settled, present with the student.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。日本文化、戦後、大きな転機を迎えました。
lines.en: Yes. Japan went through such a profound transformation after the war.
lines.style: Sincere, thoughtful. Careful articulation — she's thinking out loud with the teacher, not just answering. Slight pause before 「大きな」 to show she's choosing her words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昔は、お上を崇拝する文化、強かったのですね。
lines.en: In the old days, reverence for authority and the imperial system was deeply embedded in the culture.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Slight wondering quality — not lecturing, reflecting alongside the student. Warm cadence that invites continued dialogue.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。伝統工芸に手間を施す技、貴重ですね。
lines.en: Yes. The skill and care that goes into traditional crafts — that's truly irreplaceable.
lines.style: Sincere, grounded. Deliberate pace on「貴重」. She's connecting the abstract cultural point to something tangible. Quiet reverence for the work itself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 骨太の伝統が、現代に残っていますね。
lines.en: Those deeply rooted traditions have held their place in modern times.
lines.style: Satisfied observation. Calm, even tone. A teacher noting something important without urgency. She's seeing Sakura understand something real.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。海外の影響を通り抜けて、独自性、保ちました。
lines.en: Yes. Even with all the foreign influence flowing in, Japan held onto what made it distinct.
lines.style: Earnest, almost protective tone. She's expressing something she cares about. No hesitation — she believes this. Warm conviction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ろくな調査もせず、表面だけ論じる学者、多いですね。
lines.en: Too many scholars want to discuss the surface without doing the actual difficult work of understanding.
lines.style: Slight edge here, but not harsh — measured disapproval. Emphasis on the contrast between laziness and real research. Still composed, but her standards are showing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。伝統が次世代に根付いていく時代、応援したいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to support a time when tradition actually takes root in the next generation, not just survives.
lines.style: Closing with quiet passion. Slower on 「応援したいです」 — this is what she actually cares about. Earnest, not performative. A genuine statement of purpose.
